# Phase 13 OpenAPI surface snapshot — Wave 3 (13-04 adds api-keys).
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored by the snapshot test.
# Regenerated by Plan 13-04 from app.openapi()['paths'] after the /api/v1/api-keys
# router mounted. Only /api/v1/* paths appear; all legacy routers stay
# include_in_schema=False (13-01). /user/api-keys is absent — its child router
# carries include_in_schema=False directly (D-15). Collection paths carry a
# trailing slash because the endpoints are decorated @router.get("/") under a
# prefixed router (matches the emitted spec verbatim; the SDK calls the same strings).
